articles.title: Sports Economy Set to Reach $8.8 Trillion by 2050, But Physical Inactivity and Climate Threats Risk Billions Without Urgent Action
articles.mainIdea: Sports Economy Set to Reach $8.8 Trillion by 2050, But Physical Inactivity and Climate Threats Risk Billions Without Urgent Action
articles.summary: Business Wire: Sports Economy Set to Reach $8.8 Trillion by 2050, But Physical Inactivity and Climate Threats Risk Billions Without Urgent Action. LONDON, January 15, 2026--The sports economy is projected to reach $8.8 trillion in annual revenue by 2050, yet rising physical inactivity and escalating climate and nature risks threaten up to $517 billion of this revenue by 2030. Without coordinated multistakeholder action, potential losses could increase to as much as $1.6 trillion by 2050.
